turns.doctor_question: Did you have trouble paying attention as a child?
turns.patient_response:

She says my grade school report cards always said I was bright, which was nice of the teachers to say, but... they also usually mentioned that I had a hard time staying in my seat. 

And, um, I guess I would sometimes blurt out answers before the teacher finished asking the question. I just got so eager, you know? And I'd lose my homework... even when I had actually done it. It was just so frustrating to know I did the work and then couldn't find it.

turns.doctor_question: Have these concentration problems been present pretty much your whole adult life?

But... yeah, I suppose if I really think about it, I've always had to put in a lot of extra hours just to keep up. Like, I'd stay late at the office when everyone else went home, just because it was quieter and I could finally focus. I always just thought I was a hard worker, you know?
